China's Central Bank to Investigate Solana's Advertising Campaign in Shanghai's Lujiazui District

An official from the People's Bank of China (PBOC) said authorities recently discovered that Solana had placed advertisements in Shanghai's Lujiazui financial district through domestic entities, using brand promotion to market cryptocurrencies. The PBOC, together with local financial regulators, police, and market supervision authorities, has halted the planned Solana Accelerate China 2026 events in Shanghai and other cities and will investigate the entities and individuals involved.
